fusions.name: Landslip Wave
fusions.desc: Heaves a wave of loosened rubble ahead of you, dealing 13 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Broadside Boulder
fusions.desc: Fires a boulder that deals 40 damage. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Leaning Into It
fusions.desc: Carries you 6 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Steady Keel
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
